title: Combined femtosecond laser-assisted intracorneal ring segment implantation and corneal collagen cross-linking for correction of keratoconus

license.statement: CC BY-NC 3.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution - Non Commercial (unported, v3.0) License, with Dove Medical Press terms)

groups.description: Femtosecond laser-assisted Keraring intracorneal ring segment implantation followed by epithelium-off corneal cross-linking (0.1% riboflavin, 18 mW/cm2 for 5 min) in the same setting, for progressive keratoconus; prospective noncomparative case series of 160 eyes of 100 patients (60 bilateral). Cross-linking combined with a ring segment in one treatment, so procedure 'other'; single arm without an investigational comparator, so role control.

series.notes: Row 'BCVA (in logMAR)'; cells print mean ± SD, followed at postoperative visits by a p-value in parentheses; the leading mean is read. Unit logMAR from the row label; the table has no decimal or Snellen row. Visits are the stated preoperative, 1-, 3- and 6-month examinations. Per-visit n not given in the table; the Results text reports proportions out of 160 eyes at 1, 3 and 6 months.

exclusions.reason: p-values are not admissible (protocol inclusion 4); only the leading mean is read

exclusions.what: Results text: eyes reaching a BCVA level at 1, 3 and 6 months, eyes gaining two lines or more, lines lost
exclusions.reason: proportions reaching a threshold and lines gained are not admissible (protocol inclusion 4)
uncorrected acuity is not admissible (protocol inclusion 1); mentioned in notes only

exclusions.what: Single patient with a broken ring segment (Results)
exclusions.reason: a single case selected for a complication; no separate series

notes: BCVA unit: Table 1 labels the row 'BCVA (in logMAR)' and the abstract reports BCVA in logMAR. The inclusion criterion (BCVA less than 0.7) and a Results sentence on eyes reaching a BCVA level are written in decimal-like notation, but the table prints no decimal mean; the logMAR row is the only tabulated corrected acuity.
Both eyes of 60 of the 100 patients are included (160 eyes); eyes are not independent.
Inclusion required progressive keratoconus, poor preoperative BCVA and contact-lens intolerance (preoperative criteria). No loss to follow-up is reported.
Spherical equivalent, keratometry (K1, K2), pachymetry (Table 1) and UCVA are tabulated; not extracted (no such series in schema 1.0.0).
combined = null: same-session cataract surgery is neither stated nor explicitly ruled out (addendum 1, point 3).
